title: Grandparents, Parents and Kids: A Multi-Generation Safari
excerpt: Grandparents, parents and children on safari together: how to plan a trip that works for every generation.
body:
## Pace

Plan for the slowest and the youngest: short drives, rest at midday.

## Accommodation

Family suites, connecting rooms or private houses.

## Vehicles

Consider two vehicles: one for those who want long drives, one for those who want to rest.

## Activities

- Game drives for everyone.
- Pool time for kids.
- Cultural visits.
- Zanzibar for all ages.

## Health

Check health and insurance for older and younger travellers.

See [safari for seniors](/blog/safari-for-seniors/) and [family safari itinerary](/blog/family-safari-itinerary/). [Plan your family trip](/travel-proposal/).
